title: New Life in Christ
definition: New Life in Christ is the believer's Spirit-given life that flows from union with the risen Savior.
summary: New Life in Christ is the believer's Spirit-given participation in the resurrection life of Jesus.
christFocus: Jesus Christ rose from the dead so believers may walk in newness of life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: New life is not a religious coat placed over the old self. In Christ, believers are made alive to God and brought into a new way of being. This doctrine emphasizes transformation, new desires, new identity, and resurrection hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because Christianity is more than improvement of the old life. The Gospel announces a new creation through the risen Christ. That gives hope to people who believe their past must define their future.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live from your new identity rather than from your old labels. Look for evidence of new desires, new repentance, and new obedience. Encourage struggling believers that Christ gives life, not merely advice.
